system.description:
Cost: 1 Resolve

Range: 30 spaces

You summon a black chain to bind the guilty.

Choose a target within 30 spaces.

If you target a creature, it is Restrained. Optionally, you can link it to another object within 1 space, such as the floor.

If you target an object, you can only link it to another object within 1 space.

The chain cannot be broken, and chained creatures cannot escape by any means.

This effect lasts until the start of your next turn. You can spend 1 Resolve at the start of your turn to sustain this effect.
